subject.title: feat(gateway): propagate approvals to ancestor sessions

question: Should persisted ancestor sessions be an approved audience for sanitized descendant approval lifecycle events through sessions.messages.subscribe?
rationale: Code review can verify enforcement but cannot choose the permanent product security boundary; the PR has a protected maintainer label and intentionally broadens approval visibility beyond the source session.

options.title: Approve ancestor projection
options.body: Keep the current exact-session, explicit opt-in, record-authorized design and require live authorized-versus-unauthorized proof before merge.

options.title: Limit to source session
options.body: Remove ancestor audiences and expose replay and lifecycle events only on the approval's canonical source session.

options.title: Pause the stacked rollout
options.body: Hold this slice until the umbrella durable-approvals direction and prerequisite native-client contract are reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Approve ancestor projection
recommendation.body: Keep the current exact-session, explicit opt-in, record-authorized design and require live authorized-versus-unauthorized proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows this person introduced and recently maintained the durable approval authorization and storage foundation extended by this decision.
